newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel may consider disarming Palestinians -aide.
newsitem.headline: Israel may consider disarming Palestinians -aide.

text.p: An aide to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Sunday that Israel should consider disarming Palestinian police if attacks on Israel continue.

"For now we aren't thinking of that. But if such things will continue and such things will recur, we will have to think about that also," adviser David Bar-Illan told Israel Radio when asked if there was reason to think of disarming Palestinian police.
